policy: Game-owned powers replace new tabletop ability training. Historical source choices and acquisitions remain immutable; mapping provides their current playable benefits without stacking duplicate mappings.

powers.name: Driving Cut
powers.description: Strike with a readied melee weapon for 2/4/6 physical damage and push the target 1 square. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Sweeping Blade
powers.description: Strike enemies in a radius of 1 around an adjacent target for 2/4/6 physical damage. Allies are spared. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Execution Edge
powers.description: Your next attack within two turns deals +4 damage. Gain 1 attack Boon for two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Brace
powers.description: Reduce incoming damage by 2 until the end of your next turn. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Iron Skin
powers.description: Gain 1 physical DR for two turns. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Adamant Ward
powers.description: Absorb the next 8 damage you receive. Lasts two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Fleet Step
powers.description: Gain 3 movement this turn and disengage. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Vault
powers.description: Leap up to 4 squares to an empty visible space. Cross creatures and ground hazards, but never walls. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Rescue Line
powers.description: Pull an ally up to 4 squares toward you without provoking opportunity attacks. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Spirit Ward
powers.description: A spirit absorbs the next 4 damage an ally receives. Lasts two turns. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Phantom Sentry
powers.description: Place a spectral trap. The first creature to cross it suffers 5 mental damage. Lasts three rounds. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Spirit Crossing
powers.description: Swap places with a visible ally within 6 squares. The swap does not provoke; casting can. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Field Artisan
powers.description: Learn the smoke flask and cord recipes. Crafting takes 25% less time. Use the recipe book at camp or in town.

powers.name: Resourceful Maker
powers.description: Learn field dressing and flash powder recipes. Crafting returns a full supply; known recipes remain available without an action slot.

powers.name: Master Artisan
powers.description: Learn restoration draught and ward charm recipes. Crafting takes 50% less time; this replaces the smaller speed bonus.

powers.name: Ember Lance
powers.description: Deal 2/4/6 fire damage and apply Burning 1. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Firebreak
powers.description: Ignite a radius of 1 for three rounds. Entering or starting a turn in fire deals 2 fire damage and Burning 1 to either side. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Sunburst
powers.description: Deal 4/6/8 fire damage to enemies in a radius of 2. Allies are spared. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Winter Bolt
powers.description: Deal 2/4/6 cold damage and apply Slowed 1. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Dousing Rain
powers.description: Create shallow water in a radius of 1 for three rounds. Extinguishes fire and temporary Burning on both sides. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Glacial Wall
powers.description: Raise a three-square wall perpendicular to your aim for three rounds. Blocks travel and projectiles. Cannot cover creatures or stairs. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Guardian Link
powers.description: Intercept the next hit against an adjacent ally, spending your Reaction. Stay adjacent. Protection lasts through their next turn. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Retaliating Guard
powers.description: Prepare a melee counterattack using your Reaction after the next physical hit. Lasts through your next turn. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Hold the Line
powers.description: Allies within 2 squares gain 2 damage reduction for two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Rally
powers.description: Give an ally 1 attack Boon for two turns. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Draw Attention
powers.description: Mark an enemy to prioritize attacking you for two turns, if you are a legal target. Apply 1 attack Bane. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Second Wind
powers.description: Grant an ally one bonus Maneuver on their next turn that retains Maneuver. At most once per recipient per encounter. Cannot target yourself. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Mending Touch
powers.description: Restore 3/5/7 HP to an ally. Three uses per rest; no wound or Grit recovery.

powers.name: Renewal Circle
powers.description: Create a healing circle for three rounds. An ally starting a turn there regains 2 HP. Two uses per rest.

powers.name: Renew Flesh
powers.description: Repair one recoverable wound on an ally and restore 5 HP. One use per rest. Does not restore Grit or erase injury history.

powers.name: Barbed Arrow
powers.description: A readied bow deals 2/4/6 physical damage and Bleeding 1. Uses ammunition. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Piercing Flight
powers.description: Shoot through enemies in a line up to 7 squares for 2/4/6 physical damage. Allies are spared; walls stop the shot. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Hunter’s Focus
powers.description: Your next attack within two turns deals +3 damage. Gain 2 attack Boons for two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Field Care
powers.description: Stabilize an ally and remove temporary Bleeding. Two uses per rest. Also learn the field dressing recipe.

powers.name: Purging Tonic
powers.description: Remove temporary Poisoned, Dazed, Burning and Freezing from an ally. Two uses per rest.

powers.name: Battle Surgeon
powers.description: Restore 6/9/12 HP and stabilize an ally. Two uses per rest. Learn the restoration draught recipe.

powers.name: Fracture Focus
powers.description: Deal 1/3/5 mental damage and apply Dazed 1. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Force Hand
powers.description: Move a visible enemy 3 squares directly away from you. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Mindstorm
powers.description: Enemies in a radius of 2 suffer 2/4/6 mental damage and Dazed 1. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Guiding Light
powers.description: Illuminate a radius of 2 for three rounds and reveal concealed creatures there. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Dawn Shield
powers.description: Absorb 6 damage on an ally and remove temporary Frightened. Two uses per rest.

powers.name: Judgment’s Cone
powers.description: Enemies in a cone up to 4 squares take 4/6/8 radiant damage. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Read the Depths
powers.description: Reveal the nearby floor and its interactable objects within 8 squares. Does not reveal enemies. Usable while exploring.

powers.name: Expose Weakness
powers.description: Reduce an enemy’s DR by 1 for two turns. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Calculated Opening
powers.description: Restore a spent Reaction and grant 1 defense Boon to an ally for two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Gale Bolt

powers.name: Crosswind

powers.name: Thunder Line
powers.description: Enemies in a line up to 7 squares take 4/6/8 lightning damage and are pushed 2 squares. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.description: Become concealed for two turns. Enemies cannot target you from farther than 1 square. Attacking or taking damage ends concealment. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Smoke Screen
powers.description: Fill a radius of 1 with smoke for three rounds. Blocks sight and ranged targeting through it for both sides; adjacent targeting remains possible. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Shadow Step
powers.description: Teleport up to 6 squares to visible empty ground, then gain 1 attack Boon for two turns. Once per encounter.

powers.name: Snaring Roots
powers.description: Create difficult ground in a radius of 1 for three rounds. Costs 2 movement per square for both sides. Twice per encounter.

powers.name: Field Replenishment
powers.description: At camp or in town, replenish arrows, torches or food using their recipe and materials. Basic recipes are always known; crafting time is reduced by 25%.
